conventions.owner: This file owns Part III structure, calendar, battles, recruits, quests (rewards included) and systems. Battle drops and chest items are owned by weapons-and-items.json (`where` rows with chapter "Part III S<n>", `dungeon_chests.part3`). Classes (Master, Divine, Elephant) are owned by class-data.json. Gathering spots are owned by site/src/data/world-map.json.
conventions.relief: "relief" is Relief Points, Part III's replacement for Renown.
conventions.unconfirmed: A value ending in '?' is unconfirmed. Source conflicts live in open_questions.

overview.unlock: Door of Destiny in the Obelisk Chamber, any time after a Part II clear.
overview.point_of_no_return: Entering is the last chance to recruit on any Path. A Flame Lord brought in only through their Paralogue (Path not finished) joins as a guest with locked class and inventory. A lord's army comes only if that lord's War Path is done or skipped. Reddit confirms the 'Limited Recruitment' flag on such lords; whether they can ride in squads is unknown.
overview.storage: All weapons and items from every imported route sit in storage, refine levels kept.
overview.recruits_in_dagsion: Units recruited on earlier routes wait around Dagsion from Section 2 if that route's Part II is done. Talk to them to recruit. With copies from several routes you pick one, or merge them (Merge Causality).
overview.structure: 6 Sections. Calendar 2/1 to 6/6. Each Section after the first: Free Time (quests, repairs, exams, recruiting), then Mission Time (gates). Defeat in every battle: Eshmel falls.
overview.dungeons: Every dungeon is refreshed: higher-level enemies and a new chest set (weapons-and-items.json dungeon_chests.part3). Enemy levels rise slightly each Section.

squads: Up to 8 units per squad. 2 squads in Section 2, then 3, 4 and 5 (Section 5).
Each squad moves once per map turn; every squad must move or skip before the turn ends.
A Flame Lord's map ability works only when that lord is in the squad.
Units outside squads gain EXP and class EXP each map turn.
Disbanding and rebuilding a squad costs no turn; swapping members costs a turn.
Only units in Dagsion can use its facilities. Eshmel never joins a squad: he stays in Dagsion and can join any battle.
The squad cap rises by one after each Section's main battle, to 5 in Section 5 (ATH-P3G).
repairs: Damaged locations can't be entered: their shops and quests stay closed.
Map locations are repaired with Materials Bag items and a squad on site; repair finishes after several turns.
Dagsion facilities (Arena, Inn, temples) use Building Materials, bought at markets in repaired settlements.
Posthouses restore carriage fast travel. A repaired temple teleports only after its god's request is done.
Order: posthouses, then temples, then settlements. RPG Site finished every repair and quest with time to spare when all four routes were imported.
systems.relief: Replaces Renown from Section 2. Earned from quests (best source), repairs, skirmishes, random clashes and Theater. Rewards are Skill Treatises; no major progression is gated by it.
mission_time: Purify the miasma nodes on the map, then enter the gate. Only squads on or next to the gate deploy.
Clearing a gate early leaves the remaining turns free for exploring.
Enemy armies march on Dagsion: intercept them with a Clash before they damage the city.
A squad that launches a gate battle spends its turn.
Mission Time starts with every squad back in Dagsion (ATH-P3G).
The deploy list can mix units from every squad on or next to the gate; the squad that launches spends its map turn (G8-S3, G8-S4).
A squad patrolling the Alcineus Span to Enceladus Bridge road catches most armies marching on Dagsion (ATH-P3G); one squad bouncing between two tiles next to Dagsion is enough (YT-P3GUIDE).
systems.merge_causality: From Section 2 at the Shrine of Causality: 300 Karma Shards per character. You first pick which route version joins (the base); a merge keeps the highest of each stat across versions, plus higher skill levels, extra classes, mastered-class abilities and combat arts. Not additive. Only for units recruited on 2+ routes. A skipped Part II counts as done for imports (about +5 levels). Re-entering a route's Part II Ch 1, reclassing and skipping again applies a free single-route merge (community-reported). Each finished or skipped Part II saves that route's Clear Data; re-clearing a route merges its new results into that data for free, as long as the unit hasn't been recruited into Eshmel's army yet. After recruitment, any merge costs Karma Shards; the Flame Lords merge automatically on a re-clear. Assigned mounts and battalions stay on the unit's Clear Data (community, GameFAQs Jacien). Resetting the chapter after a merge undoes it (YT-P3GUIDE). Other Karma Shard sinks: skill-EXP Boons cost 300 each and count in battle only, not in training (G8-BOONS).
systems.trials: Each god request opens a Lv 60 Trial Clash: two back-to-back clashes, retry freely, no Game Over. Kalla's is the hardest, Credna's the easiest. Mars's Trial is one of the harder ones (G8-TRIAL).
facilities: Dagsion facilities take 37 Building Materials in all: Arena 3, Inn 2, Aiding in Prayer 7, Arena II 20, Inn II 5 (RPS-P3; total ATH-P3G, YT-P3GUIDE).
Community order: Arena, Inn, temples (Aiding in Prayer), Arena II, Inn II (YT-P3GUIDE, ATH-P3G).
Only units inside Dagsion use the Arena, Inn and temples (G8-S3).
shops: Master Licenses: the License Vendor next to the Exam Proctor (Upper Temple Row, Dagsion) sells 3 per Section at 8,000G and restocks at the next Section's start (G8-MLIC). Repaired settlement markets sell them too: 28 markets listed (G8-MLIC); their stock is undocumented ?.

Anna's Shop in Dagsion sells permanent stat boosters at 14,000G each: Seraph Robe (HP +4), Energy Drop (Str +2), Spirit Dust (Mag +2), Secret Book (Dex +2), Speedwing (Spd +2), Goddess Icon (Lck +2) (ATH-P3G).
Drifting Reliquary relics cost 500 (Answerer Arisen) to 1,000 (Chosen Sword+2) Karma Shards (ATH-P3G).
ZR lists every damaged posthouse, temple, dungeon and upgrade spot; hovering a settlement (LT on the world map) shows its armory and market stock (YT-P3GUIDE, ATH-P3G).
The Drifting Reliquary opens only after clearing a War Arc a second time (G8-RELIQ); weapons-and-items.json says after a Part II clear (see Open questions).
Elephant License: Game8 lists it with the exam licenses sold by the License Vendor beside the Exam Proctor; price and stock not published ?
farming: Theodora's battalions placed on dungeon nodes gather upgrade materials every map turn while her squad works elsewhere (YT-P3GUIDE, ATH-P3G).
Cullet and Blue Snoll: Iapetus Cavern, Pyroxene Cave, Galen Fort Ruins. Smithing Stones and common ores: Collapsed Fort (ATH-P3G).
Dungeon chests are refreshed for Part III and dungeon enemy levels rise each Section: the best EXP outside gates (RPS-P3, G8-S4).
Unlocked classes stay unlocked save-wide, even after replaying a chapter (YT-P3GUIDE, ATH-P3G).

Warrior's Soulstone: crystals in dungeons and world-map ore nodes; Northern Passage, Southern Passage and Palace of Sand (Nysiades, via Eastern Passage) are named farms. Re-enter a dungeon to refresh deposits. Soulstone also pays for repairs (G8-SOUL).
Mage battalions gather more ore at dungeon nodes, priest battalions more at resource nodes (battalions.json, Game8).
mounts: With Cai's route imported, the Stable serves every army: Inventory > Assign gives a Stable mount to any unit in a matching mounted class (G8-MOUNTS; RD-CAIMOUNTS, community).
Luring a new mount still needs Cai in the squad.
Part III breeds: Black Horse at Daimos Plateau, Red Bau at Yashiro Fort, Black Bau at Warrior's Road and Valley of Sedden (G8-MOUNTS, G8-REDBAU).
Bond 5 gives the full bonus: up to +3 to a stat and +15% growth per breed, plus the upgraded paired ability (G8-MOUNTS).

Elephants can't be lured: the Saramis War Elephant is the only elephant breed and comes only from The Elephant Rider's Bond (2 per save). No rare elephant exists (G8-CAPTURE; G8-MOUNTS and LinkKing7's full mount list agree).

diadem.opens: Temple of the Diadem (Idyia region) opens at the start of Section 4. Keys can be collected earlier.
rules: 5 Keys of the Diadem open 5 chambers holding 8 Divine License items. A key is not tied to a chamber.
Each item exists once: one holder per Divine class. Return Certification at the Exam Proctor frees it for another unit.
No level requirement; the exam needs a 100% pass chance. Classes, ranks and chambers: class-data.json.

keys.spot: Follow the lake to the end, then go right
From the rest stop, top level of the ruins on the right
The last opening of the path
Up the stairs from the start, then the southeast stairs; chest left of the square structure

sections.name: The Liberation of Dagsion
sections.intro: Run through Dagsion with a couple of class battles on the way, then a short dungeon (Rest Spot near the lift to the port). Blessings are set on the prep screen.

battles.name: Battle vs. Dagda
battles.flow: Opens as 3 units vs Dagda: deplete his first HP bar. Then the full battle starts, with allies arriving in waves.
enemies: Dagda: Underworld Boon; counts as Dragon and Flier; summons reinforcements on his first two turns, more periodically
mechanics: Miasma blocks follow-up attacks; Eshmel's and allies' Blaze Arts clear miasma in their area
Bonus floor tiles; the center Guard Spot is a good hold point
Underworld Boon: Eshmel within 2 tiles or Leda's Song of Abjuring
Celestial Blaze Arts (Orchel's Strahl, Cai's Blackfire) strip most of his shield
battles.allies_note: Each ally appears only if their Path or Paralogue was completed.
tips: Meet in the center, clear golems and adds, then Dagda

joins.how: Auto in Part III (Section ? : RPG Site lists 'Prologue and Part III')
Auto in Part III (Section ? : RPG Site lists 'Prologue and Part III')

flow: Run through Dagsion with a couple of class battles, then Battle vs. Dagda.
Allies arrive in waves on Turns 3, 5 and 7; Dagda falls and Bertrand, Orchel, Talimun and Anatolia stay.

sections.name: True Strength
unlocks: God requests (all but Aurora's, per Game8)
scenes: Dietrich, path up to the Port in Lowtown
Leda, fountain at the Arena Plaza in Midtown
Aurora, south of Temple Row (after Rescue Centurio and talking to Centurio)
Credna, his branch temple (after his request; later Sections too)
sections.scenes_note: Each lord's scene needs that lord recruited for Part III. Hidden scenes can give skill-level or weapon rewards; watched ones replay at the Shrine of Causality > Memories (G8-SCENES).

battles.name: Rescue Centurio
tips: Pull the Giants' escorts first

battles.name: Battle vs. Breza
battles.reinforcements: SE and SW sides; Rukhs from NW and NE. More after the first bridge, large birds after the second; the boss can join from there.
mechanics: Miasma: Def becomes 0 and you lose half your current HP each round. Never end a turn in it
tips: Turtle at the start, fragile units in the middle
Spam Eshmel's Purifying Flash: clears miasma, hits undead, builds gauge
Hold the right side of the tree
Kalla's Blessing to cross the bridges
Underworld Boon: Eshmel's passive or Aurora's Blessing Lv 3
Spend saved Divine Sand on Breza

joins.how: Clear Rescue Centurio, then talk to him in Dagsion (still possible in Section 3)

flow: 2/1 in Dagsion: storage holds every route's items; earlier recruits wait around Dagsion. Talk to each, pick a copy if there are several.
Arena Construction Effort starts on its own: 3 Building Materials, bought in repaired settlements.
Free Time 2/1–2/10: 2 squads, one move each per map turn. Repairs, god requests (5 of 6 open ?), refreshed dungeons.
Mission Time 2/11–2/15: squads return to Dagsion, miasma nodes and the Evermist Plain gate appear, enemy armies march on Dagsion.
Purify the nodes, then enter the gate from it or a tile next to it: 8 units + Eshmel.
Turns left after the gate are free map turns; the Section ends at its deadline.

sections.name: The Inheritors
overworld: Desert sandstorm hides path lines: save before entering
Collect the Keys of the Diadem now; the Temple opens in Section 4

battles.name: Battle vs. Shenlo
enemies: Reinforcements mostly Pegasi from the sides and bottom
mechanics: Miasma lowers weapon durability and spell charges; Blaze Arts clear it
tips: Move SE to NW along the top edge
AoE Blaze Arts on the boss group; Eshmel adjacent or Leda's Song for the Boon
Hit Shenlo with your most accurate moves
Kill the fleeing carriers fast

flow: 3rd squad. Aurora reaches Dagsion; her request shows after some time passes.
Free Time 2/16–2/25. Take the Keys of the Diadem now: the Temple opens with Section 4.
Mission Time 2/26–3/6: gate at Tarvos (Shenlo); armies march on Dagsion past the nodes. The desert sandstorm hides path lines: save first.
Shenlo's map: four Smithy Box carriers flee northwest; miasma drains durability and spell uses.
scenes: Fortuna, near the Thermae (starts the Sections 3 to 5 chain)
sections.scenes_note: Fortuna's Section 2 scene isn't needed for this chain (G8-SCENES).

sections.name: The Hopes of Monarchs and of People
overworld: Two gates at once: 3 squads north, 1 south
After Hanno, teleport Kalla's Temple to Mars's Temple for the second gate (Kalla's to Jurah's is the other link)
Don't launch a gate with your strongest squad: it spends its turn

battles.name: Battle vs. Hanno
mechanics: Heavy fog, worse inside the miasma (cuts vision)
Forests and elevation; cavalry struggles
The army starts split in 2 groups
tips: Credna's Blessing for vision
Swap Spaces so both halves have melee and a healer
Turtle, merge, push to the bottom right
Bring fliers
Keep Hanno off forest tiles
Save Divine Sand

battles.name: Battle vs. Baozi
enemies: Some enemies high Lv 50s, many mid 40s
mechanics: Pride miasma: the higher-level unit gets an accuracy drop
Aggroing Baozi buffs every golem
tips: Kill all golems before touching Baozi
Stay out of the miasma above Lv 58
Bring high-Hit units

flow: 4th squad. The Temple of the Diadem (Idyia) opens: 5 keys open 5 chambers with 8 Divine items. Reclass in Dagsion.
Free Time 3/7–3/21: finish every quest and repair here; Section 5 is for training.
Mission Time 3/22–4/5: two gates at once. Hanno at Ere Mountains (north, 17 units) and Baozi at Daimos Plateau (west, 9).
After Hanno, Kalla's Temple teleports to Mars's Temple near Daimos (or to Jurah's).
scenes: Fortuna, near the Thermae (needs the Section 3 scene)
sections.scenes_note: Fortuna's Section 2 scene isn't needed for this chain (G8-SCENES).

sections.name: Song of the Living

joins.how: Auto at Section start, if alive at the end of Part II Ch 3
Auto at Section start, if alive at the end of Part II Ch 3

overworld: Three gates. Order: Cohen and Maria first (nearest Dagsion, hardest, 3 squads), then Drake, then Mahadu (1 squad)
Aragona or Cartodo Posthouse to the top-left gate; Salacia Posthouse or by sea to the bottom-right gate
Enemy armies don't travel by sea

battles.name: Battle vs. Cohen and Maria
enemies: Maria near the center with reinforcements
mechanics: Lust miasma: lower Hit (and Avoid, per RPG Site) when the foe's Charisma beats yours
Miasma tiles shift every couple of turns: don't spend turns clearing them
Cavalry struggles
tips: One squad east, one south; advance slowly
Kill Maria first, then pull Cohen into the center chokepoint
High-Cha units and archers

battles.name: Battle vs. Drake
mechanics: Desert: no cavalry
Envy miasma spawns where you defeat an enemy (larger for named foes): doubles Hit but sets Avoid to 0 against higher-level foes
Picking up the pirate treasure negates Envy
Treasure chests on the map, mostly gold
tips: Fliers and mages
Rush Drake with Kalla's Blessing and kill nothing on the way, or ball up in the center

battles.name: Battle vs. Mahadu
mechanics: Wrath miasma: doubles Crit, halves Def (both sides)
Forests and brush
tips: Move north through the forests
Kill the enemies nearest Klapka first
Drag Mahadu out of the brush before the kill
Kalla's Blessing against crits

flow: Aswan and Tahonia join at the start if alive after War Ch 3. 5th squad.
Free Time 4/6–4/25: training. Dungeons, Trials and refines.

Mission Time 4/26–5/15: three gates. Cohen and Maria (Fort Hecatoncheires, just south of Dagsion, 17), Drake (Valley of Death, far northwest, 17), Mahadu (Kurdelind Ruins, far southeast, 9, Klapka as guest).
Enemy armies don't travel by sea.
Klapka joins only if he survives Mahadu and you enter Dagsion right after the battle.
scenes: Fortuna, near the Thermae (needs the Section 4 scene)
sections.scenes_note: Fortuna's Section 2 scene isn't needed for this chain (G8-SCENES).

sections.name: To the Edge of Twilight
sections.intro: Last Free Time: every quest and god request ends 6/6. Go to the Temple of Balor when ready.

joins.how: If he survived the Mahadu battle and you returned to Dagsion with Eshmel right after it. Needs Theodora's Path cleared (Game8).

battles.name: Showdown vs. Lyrah
enemies: Summoned enemies across the map after her first defeat
mechanics: Fear miasma confuses; it spawns where enemies move (larger for big ones) and fades after a few turns
After her first bar she reverts to humanoid form and your units are rearranged
She teleports away when approached until she settles at the map edge
tips: Hold one area, clear reinforcements, then chase her with fliers (they skip the miasma)

battles.name: Temple of Balor
battles.flow: Three areas with chests (consumables) and Rest Spots.

battles.name: Balor's Last Stand
enemies: Balor: multiple HP bars behind a barrier
mechanics: Destroying 2 gates drops his barrier; damage him the same turn, it returns next turn
Repeat once per HP bar
He counters with a plus-shaped AoE: spread out
Purple cross-shaped warnings mark incoming attacks
He ignites platforms and spews miasma: both deal heavy damage at the start of your turn
battles.formation: Strongest unit or two, a healer and a Dancer near Balor; fast units on the side teams break gates and stop reinforcements. Troy is the players' pick to run gates solo (high Avo, a healing accessory); Bolting users hit gates from range (Reddit, community: https://www.reddit.com/r/fireemblem/comments/1wn1jp4/completed_a_routeless_run_of_fortunes_weave/). Hong Hua's Wandering Wall helps here.

sections.after: A short dungeon, then a final easy battle. Pick which Lv 5 A support becomes S, then epilogues and credits. No post-game or NG+: the save returns to before the final boss.
flow: Klapka joins if kept alive. Last Free Time 5/16–6/6, no Mission Time: every quest and god request ends 6/6.
Enter the Temple of Balor when ready: Showdown vs. Lyrah (17), a three-area dungeon with chests and Rest Spots, then Balor's Last Stand (25: 3 squads + Eshmel).
After Balor: a short dungeon and one easy battle, then pick which Lv 5 A support becomes S. Epilogues; the save returns to before the final boss.

missables.text: Last chance to recruit on every Path. A lord with only a Paralogue clear joins as a locked guest.
Every quest and god request ends 6/6. Temple repairs take several turns: start early.
Rescue Centurio, then talk to Centurio in Dagsion.
Fortuna's scene near the Thermae each Section; Sections 4 and 5 need the previous one.
Optional scenes: each lord in Dagsion (Cai, Dietrich, Theodora, Leda), Aurora after Centurio's rescue, Fortuna near the Thermae.
Shenlo map: four Smithy Box carriers flee NW.
Talk to Credna again: The Nameless becomes the Shining Spear. Nothing marks it.
Cohen and Maria map: treatise carriers flee.
Keep Klapka alive vs Mahadu, then return to Dagsion with Eshmel right away.
Collect all 5 Keys of the Diadem (Part III chests only).

open_questions: Section 1 ally waves: RPG Site lists Theodora on both Turn 3 and Turn 5; one is probably Dietrich.
Rescue Centurio: RPG Site says it 'may require Cai brought into Part III'; Game8 names no requirement.
God requests start: Game8 lists five from Section 2 (Aurora's from Section 3); RPG Site lists all six in Section 3.
Elephant Rider's Bond: Game8 says it can only be done in Section 2; RPG Site and KeenGamer give a 6/6 deadline.
Shining Spear: RPG Site says talk to Credna after repairing his temple; Game8 says after finishing his request.
Dance for Rebuilt Cities: Game8 places it in Section 2 right after Villages; RPG Site in Section 4.
Lust miasma: RPG Site says Hit and Avoid drop, Game8 says Hit only.
Envy miasma: RPG Site says double Hit and 0 Avoid vs higher levels; Game8 says it 'confuses hit and avoid'.
Lyrah's final spot: RPG Site says she moves to the west side; Game8 says bottom right.
Balor: RPG Site says 4 HP bars (8 gates); Game8 says 3 cycles with a larger 3rd bar. Game8's box says 17 units, its text 25 (3 squads + Eshmel); RPG Site says 25.
Cohen and Maria: RPG Site says a two-squad battle; Game8 recommends sending 3 squads.
Kalla's Temple repair material; which towns sell Building Materials and the price.
What happens if an enemy army damages Dagsion in Mission Time.
Part III shop stock changes; Part III boss weapon drops (none documented).
True ending: no source names a condition. The final easy battle after Balor may be what videos call the true ending.
Anna's Shop: the video also mentions items that raise Mov; allthings.how lists only the six stat boosters.
allthings.how lists Lysander with Bertrand and Orchel as Paralogue joiners in Part III; every other source names Talimun and Anatolia.
Mount bond: whether bond stays with the mount when it is reassigned to another unit is undocumented.
Saramis War Elephant bond 5 growths: Game8's mount list gives +5% each; the mount guide data gives +10%.
Master License price: Game8 gives 8,000G at the Dagsion License Vendor; allthings.how gives 5,600G (maybe the market price).
Drifting Reliquary unlock: Game8 says after a second War Arc clear; weapons-and-items.json part_carryover says after a Part II clear.
Teach Secrets in Part III: whether units from other armies can learn Dietrich's Hidden arts is unconfirmed.
Whether Part III Section scenes can be recovered by replaying the Section is unconfirmed.
Elephant License price and stock per Section: no source gives them.
Elephant Rider auras: does an 'adjacent allies' ability count from all 4 tiles of the 2×2 body (8 neighbours)? One Reddit thread says yes; untested. The Section 4 plan tests it with Gaitz.
Elephant Rider Dismount: whether it ends the unit's turn, and whether the dismounted unit can use staves or tomes.
Heavy Charge: lane width (Part II enemy elephants charged 2-wide lanes), length, damage and uses per map are unpublished.
